name: Granite Shieldarm
description: Takes the court stance beside a partner with both boards slanted inward to form one shared front.

name: Adamantine Edgeband
description: Swaps cover with the partner mid-exchange so the board that is struck is always the fresher one.

name: Wardwrath
description: Raps the rim across the opponent's lead hand while the partner's board guards the open flank.

name: Prescient Bossrim
description: Breathes to the shared count so both bearers hold and move on the same instant.

name: Mightface
description: Pivots around the partner's shoulder to take the other's front without opening a gap in cover.

name: Thorn Backbrace
description: Joins both bearers' qi in a single brace so a blow on one board spreads through both.

name: Sanguine Enarme
description: Swaps places behind crossed boards and shoves the opponent into the partner's waiting rim.

name: Thorn Buffet
description: Leans both boards onto one opponent's weapon and arm and pins them between the two faces.

name: Septic Rim
description: Overlaps the two partners' qi fields so the ground between the boards is warded from every strike.

name: Faceruin
description: Smashes both boards forward as one mass and drives qi through the opponent's guard to the body beneath.

name: Strap Hardihood
description: Holds the paired fields at one pitch so an incoming technique unravels against their shared edge.

name: Unconquered Face
description: Unfurls the guard sideways with the shield as the leading feather of a widening wing.

name: Unbudging Strap
description: Braces the shoulder at the wing's root so the extended board cannot be levered aside.

name: Wardruin
description: Flicks the outer rim like a feather tip across the opponent's brow to force the head back.

name: Silt Backboard
description: Steps along the wing's width to meet the strike where the guard is thinnest.

name: Unassailable Boss
description: Casts the guard wide over an ally at the bearer's shoulder so blows meant for them strike the board.

name: Thorn Cover
description: Folds the wing shut around an opponent's arm and pinches it fast between board and hip.

name: Wicked Rim
description: Spreads the qi field in a sheltering wing across the bearer and allies standing within its reach.

name: Unassailable Bossrim
description: Beats the open wing once against a heavy attack and returns its force along the arc of the stroke.

name: Backbrace Respite
description: Raises a wide wing of shared qi over every ally in reach and strengthens each ally's own guard.

name: Blinding Shoulderset
description: Opens the first track with a broad step that draws the enemy line toward the lead shield.

name: Evergreen Boss
description: Holds the second track's shield back while the first strikes so one board always covers.

name: Strapwrath
description: Alternates rim jabs between the two tracks so the opponent cannot answer both.

name: Bossblink
description: Pivots the pair so the cover and strike tracks change places in one beat.

name: Remnant Edgeband
description: Glances along the enemy front for the one shield or spear that stands slightly out of line.

name: Hourface
description: Advances both tracks locked at a fixed gap and pushes the enemy front slowly back.

name: Enarmewrath
description: Drives both tracks into one point of the enemy line in a wedge of boards.

name: Mayhem Ward
description: Beats first at one guard then the other so the enemy's formation breaks its own rhythm.

name: Bashhavoc
description: Surges both boards forward on the same count to break through a bracing enemy.

name: Rimscourge
description: Converges both tracks' qi fields on the enemy front in a single forward surge.

name: Strapruin
description: Wedges the boards into a gap with qi sharpening the edges so the line parts like cloth.

name: Buffetmettle
description: Presses both tracks' fields on the enemy front and lowers the strength of each fighter caught in it.

name: Unbudging Face
description: Perches high on the toes with the board raised and the weight ready to drop forward.

name: Siltbuffet
description: Lunges down the line of attack with the board leading like a hawk's falling breast.

name: Mayhem Shieldarm
description: Hooks the rim over the opponent's weapon arm and strips it down with a talon motion.

name: Elevating Face
description: Fixes the eyes on one point of the opponent's body and ignores all the feints.

name: Buffetruin
description: Drops the board's whole face onto the opponent from above with the bearer's weight behind it.

name: Strapvortex
description: Springs back up from the dive onto the toes with the board raised before the next blow.

name: Murk Boss
description: Rolls the board's raised face over a downward blow and sends it onto the ground.

name: Nova Bash
description: Plunges the board down onto a guard with the qi gathered at the rim and breaks through it.

name: Unrelenting Backboard
description: Raises the board overhead with the field spread above it against blows that fall from the sky.

name: Facetward
description: Dives the board on a single point of the opponent's defence with the whole qi field forced into the rim.

name: Unconquered Enarme
description: Settles the board and the stance into the shape of a bowl that catches every blow.

name: Inexorable Shieldarm
description: Leans the board to the current of the opponent's attack and lets it flow along the face.

name: Tempered Bash
description: Chops the rim down on the opponent's reaching arm at the very lip of the guard.

name: Clairvoyant Backboard
description: Breathes slowly as the blows settle like silt so the mind stays clear for the next.

name: Enarmeglimmer
description: Steps out along the stream of the opponent's rush and lets the board turn it by.

name: Adamantine Strap
description: Funnels several blows toward one point of the board where qi spreads them into the ground.

name: Invincible Enarme
description: Anchors the stance into the floor of the basin so the guard cannot be moved.

name: Overpowering Ward
description: Spins the board in an eddy and bashes the opponent's weapon from its line.

name: Evergreen Edgeband
description: Fills the basin with a dense qi field that holds against a prolonged barrage of cuts.

name: Evergreen Backbrace
description: Lets the filled basin spill its gathered force back through the board in one return.

name: Fastening Bossrim
description: Bends the guard round a technique's pattern like a river round a stone and dissolves it.

name: Poisoned Shieldarm
description: Raises a rising barrier of qi in the basin's lip to hold the line against a charge.

name: Glamour Backboard
description: Takes a heavy attack into the basin and sends the whole river of its force back at the attacker.

name: Impervious Rim
description: Stands back to back with a partner so each board faces the opposite side of the field.

name: Enarmeblink
description: Matches the partner's pace so the two boards turn together as the pair advances.

name: Facewrath
description: Echoes the partner's rim strike one beat later so the opponent must face two blows.

name: Rim Fortitude
description: Overlaps the partner's qi field on the guard so each board draws strength from both.

name: Shoulderset Scourge
description: Answers a blow on one board with a counter from the partner at the same moment.

name: Facespine
description: Pinches an opponent's weapon between two boards and holds it with joined qi.

name: Enarme Durance
description: Rebounds a heavy attack from one field into the other and out through both boards.

name: Daybreak Buffet
description: Surges the two boards outward together with overlapping fields to hurl back all around.

name: Backbrace Durance
description: Holds the pair's mirrored fields in a standing ward that grows stronger the longer both hold.

name: Iron Bossrim
description: Opens the compendium's forms with a low guard that every later form returns to.

name: Torrential Shove
description: Walks the court in a measured footfall that keeps the board between bearer and attacker.

name: Rimruin
description: Knocks the rim against the opponent's guard to find the weak side.

name: Waning Edgeband
description: Breathes to sense the whole body's balance at the highest mortal-tier reach of the art.

name: Unbowed Boss
description: Pivots in a small court circle and turns a charge by the board's shoulder.

name: Granite Strap
description: Drives qi through the full meridian network into the board for a steadier guard.

name: Sanguine Buffet
description: Bashes the board into the opponent as the stepping court pattern closes on them.

name: Harnessing Shoulderset
description: Pins the opponent's weapon against the ground by the weight of the court's whole stance.

name: Hourstrap
description: Pushes the board forward with the meridian network driving each step to wear the enemy down.

name: Face Mettle
description: Turns the board through a full circle that carries a heavy blow back to its source.

name: Indomitable Boss
description: Closes the court's whole pattern around an incoming technique and unravels its structure.

name: Backboard Hardihood
description: Holds one foot high like a hawk and the board low like a river for a double stance.

name: Evergreen Strap
description: Lets the rim slip with the flow of the attack and turn it along the board.

name: Bossruin
description: Dips low then strikes upward with the rim in a hawk's sudden climb.

name: Remnant Shieldarm
description: Reads which blow carries the opponent's full commitment and prepares the answer.

name: Siltface
description: Steps in a wide arc like a hawk riding a river's air and returns behind the board.

name: Shovescourge
description: Turns the opponent's force past the board and strikes as it passes the guard.

name: Shovespine
description: Dives the board at an opponent's raised weapon and breaks the form it was about to take.

name: Unassailable Rim
description: Takes the attack on the board and sends its force back in a hawk-fast thrust.

name: Titanic Buffet
description: Presses the board forward with a steady downward and onward force that wears down the foe.

name: Glamour Edgeband
description: Gathers every blow of the exchange in the board and returns them all in one decisive shove.

name: Obdurate Backbrace
description: Raises the board into the face of the oncoming push with the sworn words spoken under the breath.

name: Enarme Fortitude
description: Sets the heels against a hard push of wind or enemy and leans the whole body into the board.

name: Blaze Shoulderset
description: Strikes with the rim into the push so the opponent's own force adds to the blow.

name: Face Respite
description: Reads the rise of the opponent's attack the way a sailor reads a coming gust.

name: Unbowed Backboard
description: Spreads the qi field over the sworn stance so blows from every quarter strike the same held guard.

name: Gust Shieldarm
description: Veers the board across the blow's line like a gust shifting direction and carries it wide.

name: Brutalizing Shove
description: Pushes the attacker back a step at a time while the bearer never gives up the sworn ground.

name: Equipoise Edgeband
description: Beats the board against a technique at its weakest point and scatters its qi like a broken wind.

name: Mayhem Shove
description: Surges the board outward with the field behind it so all attackers close to the bearer are thrown back.

name: Inexorable Verity Bossrim
description: Stands under the oath's full field and returns each blow that lands as a wind turned back.

name: Evergreen Rim
description: Plants the shield on the chosen ground and speaks the oath to hold it until relieved.

name: Obdurate Enarme
description: Locks the shoulder behind the board so it stays at the oath's height under any strain.

name: Wardscourge
description: Chops the rim down on whoever reaches the sworn ground without leaving it.

name: Faceblink
description: Strides along the plateau's edge in long even steps with the board toward the open side.

name: Clairvoyant Backbrace
description: Counts the words of the oath in time with the breath to keep the arm steady.

name: Adamantine Bossrim
description: Anchors the qi field to the sworn ground so the bearer cannot be pushed from it.

name: Obdurate Boss
description: Slants the board at the plateau's edge and turns charges off the cliff-side of the stance.

name: Enarmevalor
description: Hooks the rim round the attacker's weapon arm and pulls them off the sworn ground's border.

name: Devastating Cover
description: Shoves with the board while speaking the oath's last words and drives the attacker back.

name: Remorseless Strap
description: Spreads the oath's qi across the sworn ground so every step an enemy takes on it is hampered.

name: Inexorable Edgeband
description: Returns an attack's force to the one who struck at the oath-keeper's board.

name: Shadestrap
description: Spreads the oath-field outward until every enemy standing on the plateau grows weaker and slower.

name: Rim Nerve
description: Sets the stance on a chosen bearing and lines the board along it against every force.

name: Obdurate Shieldarm
description: Leans the board a fixed amount into each blow so the bearing does not shift.

name: Torrential Ward
description: Pivots back to the held bearing after every strike so the guard is never lost.

name: Beneficent Face
description: Extends a thin field of qi to feel whether the stance has drifted from its bearing.

name: Gnashing Bash
description: Presses the shoulder through the board along the held bearing into the attacker's centre.

name: Gust Backbrace
description: Turns the edge against a blow without moving the stance from its bearing.

name: Unbowed Enarme
description: Holds the board true against the heaviest blows by driving qi down the bearing line.

name: Glamour Bossrim
description: Rebounds the blow along the held bearing and lets it fall on the attacker in return.

name: Flintlike Backboard Tenacity
description: Holds a single bearing under every attack until the technique striking it comes apart.

name: Impenetrable Face
description: Stands like a rock in a gale with the board square before the body.

name: Impervious Boss
description: Slants the board so a charge splits to either side of the bearer and not on him.

name: Enarmehavoc
description: Hammers the rim down into the lead rank of a charge to disrupt its pace.

name: Prescient Strap
description: Counts the oncoming rank by the sound of their feet to judge when the break will come.

name: Silt Shoulderset
description: Shuffles back a half step as the charge lands to take the first shock without breaking.

name: Indomitable Bossrim
description: Meets the host's front with qi in every limb and holds as the whole weight lands.

name: Blazestrap
description: Shoves at the instant of the charge's peak and sends the lead attackers staggering back.

name: Chime Buffet
description: Beats the rim against the front rank's weapons and scatters the rhythm of the whole host.

name: Backboard Durance
description: Raises a qi field before the board that slows every enemy who tries to cross it.

name: Daybreak Shoulderset
description: Surges the board forward with the field behind it to break the front of a closing host.

name: Evergreen Glint Face
description: Takes a host's full charge on the board and returns the whole force as one great shove.

name: Inexorable Boss
description: Takes the stance of the oath that no blow will bend and settles the board at the heart.

name: Inexorable Rim
description: Keeps the board up on a wounded arm by shifting its weight onto the shoulder.

name: Decimating Ward
description: Raps the rim with what strength remains to keep an opponent from closing the last gap.

name: Shieldarm Tenacity
description: Moves the board over a fallen neighbour's side so the line's cover is not broken.

name: Healing Strap
description: Recalls the oath in a single breath to bring the wavering will back to the guard.

name: Charter Enarme
description: Binds a cracked board with qi so it holds together through a few more blows.

name: Blaze Cover
description: Strikes from the brink of collapse with a bash driven by qi from the last reserve.

name: Bashspine
description: Pins the attacker's weapon against the ground and holds it while the oath keeps the bearer fixed.

name: Unrelenting Edgeband
description: Braces against a failing line with qi drawn from the oath and holds the ground.

name: Revitalizing Backboard
description: Spreads the oath's qi along the line to restore the strength of tired bearers beside the speaker.

name: Charter Backbrace
description: Cancels an attack's pattern at the instant it would break the line by meeting it with the oath.

name: Hellish Buffet
description: Pushes forward with all that remains of the line and drives the enemy back a pace at a time.

name: Indomitable Enarme
description: Holds the guard by the oath alone against every blow while any breath remains in the bearer.

name: Facet Backbrace
description: Takes the first stance of the teachings with the board square to the plateau's open edge.

name: Enarmeflash
description: Steps along the cliff-side with the board toward the drop and the free hand on the grip.

name: Tempered Buffet
description: Flicks the rim at the opponent's feet to drive them toward the plateau's edge.

name: Illuminating Boss
description: Reads the updraft at the edge for the opponent's weight shifting before they step.

name: Inexorable Bossrim
description: Anchors the whole meridian network to the ground so the board cannot be forced aside.

name: Bashruin
description: Bashes the opponent toward the drop at the plateau's edge with the full network driving it.

name: Inexorable Strap
description: Cuts the board across a blow at the edge and carries it off the plateau.

name: Intentrim
description: Grinds the board against the opponent and walks them backward along the edge.

name: Flintlike Face
description: Returns a heavy blow through the board with the whole body anchored at the plateau's edge.

name: Unassailable Verity Edgeband
description: Stands on the edge with the whole network driving the board and dissolves attacks that strike it.

name: Unbudging Shieldarm
description: Stands upright and still with the board lowered while the opponent's attack builds.

name: Shieldarm Insight
description: Breathes evenly through the rise of the assault and watches the first sign of commitment.

name: Ironbash
description: Taps the rim into the attacker's wrist as the first blow falls and breaks its line.

name: Backbrace Nerve
description: Raises the board in an instant to catch a blow the opponent thought unguarded.

name: Bosswrath
description: Meets the full rise of the assault with a single shove timed to its crest.

name: Strapmettle
description: Disrupts the opponent's stride by not moving and letting the board catch their lead foot.

name: Thorn Edgeband
description: Swells the qi field around the stillness until blows against it lose their strength.

name: Unassailable Enarme
description: Takes the whole rise of an assault on the board and returns it in a single shove.

name: Iron Cover
description: Answers the full assault with a single qi-driven shove that pierces the attacker's guard.

name: Unconquered Rim
description: Sets the board at the place where the last allies fell and holds it as their remembrance.

name: Thorn Bossrim
description: Grips the handle with both hands and the strap with the forearm for a guard that cannot be opened.

name: Wardflash
description: Steps across the fallen line with the board turned to cover the open side.

name: Bosshavoc
description: Strikes with the rim at the first enemy to cross the empty ground the line once held.

name: Illuminating Strap
description: Breathes the names of the fallen to keep the arm firm and the mind clear.

name: Obdurate Face
description: Turns in place with the board held out to turn blows arriving from every side.

name: Coverscourge
description: Bashes with all of the strength left in the arm and the qi left in the field.

name: Thorn Ward
description: Presses the board over an attacker's weapon and holds it for the oath's sake.

name: Granite Boss
description: Spreads the qi field close round the lone bearer in a dense standing guard.

name: Glamour Rim
description: Returns each heavy blow through the board in an unbroken answer from the one who stands alone.

name: Invincible Strap Fortitude
description: Holds the last guard under the oath until the pattern of every attack on it breaks up.
